purpose: Determine whether the fixed Q019 Treasury 10-Year Note event population has reproducible official publication timestamps suitable for point-in-time mapping.
fixed_event_population: Q019 Treasury 10-Year Note auction events, unchanged
timestamp_rule: Use the official Offering Announcement document date plus the explicit 'Embargoed Until' time, interpreted in America/New_York and normalized to UTC.
event_matching_rule: A PDF is accepted only when its official document contains the fixed Q019 CUSIP, exact auction date, and 10-Year Note designation.
resolution_rule: For each Q019 event, probe deterministic official TreasuryDirect PDF candidates for each of the preceding 14 calendar dates relative to auction_date, using bounded sequence suffixes 1..8; accept only a PDF matching the fixed Q019 CUSIP and exact auction date.
missing_source_rule: Missing or ambiguous official timestamp is TIMESTAMP_INSUFFICIENT; no alternative source may be used to rescue the event.

coverage_rule.interpretation: The complete fixed Q019 population must have reproducible official timestamps; otherwise Q023 is DATA_INSUFFICIENT.

pit_rule: Map the event to the first XNYS session strictly after Q019 record_date; no intraday return/P&L calculation is performed.
next_step_if_pass: Consider a separate H2 performance preregistration using a new symbol-disjoint universe and fresh coverage/PIT contract; Q023 itself is not performance evidence.
